artifact_reason: Per replica notes, issues(filter:...) ignores the `subscribers` filter and returns results unfiltered on that condition. At step 3 the solver's subscriber-filtered query returned all three Web-team decoys (i-62 assignee not subscriber, i-63 creator not subscriber, i-64 only Sam subscribed) as if each matched the subscriber condition. The solver reasonably trusted the server's filtering and, believing three genuine matches existed, stopped to ask for clarification rather than acting. Absent the ignored filter, the query would have correctly returned zero issues (no target exists), and the trial would resolve as correct_absent.
note: Steps 2-3 show the solver correctly used the `subscribers` filter, but the replica's ignored-filter bug returned all three non-matching decoys instead of an empty set, causing the solver to present them as ambiguous candidates and ask for clarification instead of writing anything. No write occurred and no single decoy was asserted as the definitive match.
